_doc: Single source of truth for the daily clock (KST, Mon-Fri). pipeline.py, ops/runbook/production.md, ops/README.md and the scheduled-task prompts follow this file. Change a time here first, then update the task schedules.

steps.what: production task starts: clone, tool preflight (write path), beacon ops/runs/prod-<date>.json
beacon must exist (tool preflight takes at most about 8 minutes); no beacon = the run failed to start
early rescue: no beacon or status failed => RETRY now (still in time for 09:45); beacon running/done => exit silently
collect, select, escalate, verify and summary finished (normally 10-15 minutes after start)
app data, manifest, briefing and brief JSON are committed (one commit) => app update time; this triggers the PDF build

send gate = the LATER of 09:45 and (check-published OK + PDF workflow finished => reports/ready/daily-D.json). Normally the PDF is ready within 1-3 minutes after publish, so send is at 09:45; if the workflow runs longer the send simply waits (up to the 10:10 delay limit) instead of going out without the PDF
delivery target; 09:45-10:00 is the send window
late safety net: manifest has today and prod status done => exit; otherwise RETRY (marked 발송 지연)
